title: DUUI Integration of neermatch
content: Added a standalone DUUI component for advanced record matching using neermatch as part of CIRCLET. The component integrates deep learning-based entity and record matching into DUUI workflows and includes documentation for installation, model training, and pipeline usage. Support for a ready-to-use baseline model and performance evaluation results will be added after testing. Read more: https://py-neer-match.pikappa.eu/ https://github.com/texttechnologylab/duui-uima/tree/main/duui-neer-match
author: Tim Wolf

title: CIRCLET Anonymization Workshop - 8 July 2026 | Please complete our short needs survey by 15 June
content: This update invites SPP 2431 project members, affiliated research projects, and researchers working with sensitive, personal, or survey-based data to the CIRCLET Anonymization Workshop hosted by the Text Technology Lab at Goethe University Frankfurt. The hybrid workshop will take place on 8 July 2026 and will address anonymization challenges, GDPR-related foundations, and practical workflows with CIRCLET and DUUI. Interested participants are asked to complete the needs-assessment survey by 15 June 2026: https://anonworkshop.survey.spp.texttechnologylab.org/
author: Ali Abusaleh

title: Added a DUUI-Based Component for creating embeddings using self hosted models in Ollama
content: This update adds a Dockerized DUUI component for creating sentence embeddings using models hosted in Ollama. This will be later used to create embeddings of documents before adding them to UCE.
author: Daniel Bundan

title: DUUI Integration of Climate Classification Models
content: Added a new DUUI component for climate-related text classification. The component integrates selected Hugging Face based ClimateBERT models into DUUI and supports climate sentiment analysis, TCFD classification, climate commitment detection, and climate specificity classification. The update includes the new duui-Climate module with Docker support, DUUI integration files, model configuration, documentation, and tests. The supported models include distilroberta-base-climate-sentiment, distilroberta-base-climate-tcfd, distilroberta-base-climate-commitment, and distilroberta-base-climate-specificity.
author: Mevlüt Bagci

title: DUUI Integration of Genre Classification Models
content: Added a new DUUI component for genre classification. The component enables document or text segment classification using selected transformer-based genre models. The update includes the new duui-Genre module with Docker support, DUUI Lua and Python integration files, documentation, service scripts, and tests. The integrated models include turkunlp-genre-multi, turkunlp-genre-en, turkunlp-genre-finerweb, ssharoff-genre, and x-genre-classifier, covering both English and multilingual genre classification use cases.
author: Mevlüt Bagci

title: Six New Sentiment Models for DUUI
content: Added six new sentiment models to the DUUI sentiment component. The update extends multilingual and domain-specific sentiment analysis support with finance-focused models for Chinese and French, Twitter sentiment models for Polish, and a climate-related sentiment model for English. The newly added models are finance-sentiment-zh, finance-sentiment-zh-fast, finance-sentiment-fr, twitter-sentiment-pl-base, twitter-sentiment-pl-fast, and distilroberta-base-climate-sentiment.
author: Mevlüt Bagci

title: Two New DUUI Topic Classification Models
content: Added two new topic classification models to the DUUI transformers topic component. The update extends multilingual topic classification capabilities with multilingual-topic-classifier and parlacap-topic-classifier. The changes include updated model documentation, Docker build configuration, requirements, and tests for the DUUI topic pipeline.
author: Mevlüt Bagci
